title: Multi-sheet Excel upload (Delhivery, Ekart, Movin)
evidence: Successfully parsed 3 sheets from 'Shypfy B2B Rate Card Courier Wise_50 (3).xlsx'. Sheet names: [Delhivery, Ekart, Movin Standard Premium].

title: Courier Zone Matrix dynamic dimensions (16x16 & 14x14) and directional pricing
evidence: Delhivery: 16×16 (256 rates), Ekart: 16×16 (256 rates), Movin: 14×14 (196 rates, N4/S4 dynamically omitted). Directional pricing preserved (Delhivery N1->S1: ₹8/kg vs S1->N1: ₹8.76/kg).

title: Additional Charges & Calculation Types (Fixed, %, Invoice %, Per KG, Per Box, Higher of Min, Accessorials)
evidence: All calculation types passed: Docket: ₹65, Fuel: ₹54, FOV (0.2% of ₹50k): ₹100, Heavy Pkg (₹2/kg): ₹72, Box Fee: ₹100, Mall Entry (Higher of ₹500 or variable): ₹500. Demurrage isolated to post-shipment schedule.

title: Manual editing and live modification of imported matrix rates
evidence: Matrix rate successfully modified from ₹8/kg (Base Freight: ₹160) to ₹9.5/kg (Base Freight: ₹190). Server recalculated with 100% precision.

title: Draft -> Active approval workflow with safe archival & rollback
evidence: Verified 3-step lifecycle: (1) Excel import created in DRAFT (isActive=false), (2) Activation safely archived previous card-1 and set card-2 ACTIVE, (3) Rollback restored card-1 and archived card-2 with complete audit trail.

title: Merchant Markup & Selling Price Calculation (Percentage, Per KG, Per Docket)
evidence: All markup types verified: Percentage (+15%: +₹30, selling: ₹300, margin: 10%), Fixed Per KG (+₹2/kg: +₹50, selling: ₹320), Fixed Per Docket (+₹40: +₹40, selling: ₹310), None (Cost pass-through).

title: Seller Step 4 API Contract & Backend Rate Integration
evidence: Payload structure in Seller Step 4 binds directly to /api/v1/pricing/b2b/calculate. Server returns authoritative breakdown (Chargeable Wt: 25 KG, Base Freight: ₹200, Grand Total: ₹344.56), with zero mock values.

title: RATE_NOT_CONFIGURED guard enforcement when corridor is unconfigured
evidence: When route N1 -> NE2 was requested with missing rate, engine strictly rejected with 'ZONE_ROUTE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Commercial rate is not configured from origin zone N1 to destination zone NE2'. Controller maps this to code 'RATE_NOT_CONFIGURED' and prevents fake pricing.

details.errorReceived: ZONE_ROUTE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Route N1 → NE2 has no rate per kg configured in this rate card.

title: Courier-Specific Pincode-to-Zone mapping and override support
evidence: Pincode resolution supports exact pincode, prefix-2, and prefix-3 courier mapping overrides. Pincode 110001 resolved to 'METRO_NCR' and 560001 resolved to 'SOUTH_METRO' when custom mapping supplied.

title: RBAC Security: Non-admin & merchant users blocked from modifying rates (403 Forbidden)
evidence: RBAC strictly enforced by requirePlatformAdmin middleware: Merchant role 'OWNER' returned 403 Forbidden. Platform Admin 'SUPER_ADMIN' allowed access.

error.message: Forbidden. Platform administrator privileges required to access this resource.

title: Rate Card Version History & Immutable Audit Logging
evidence: Audit log actions registered and tracked for all rate card modifications: [B2B_RATE_CARD_CREATED, B2B_RATE_CARD_UPDATED, B2B_RATE_CARD_STATUS_TOGGLED, B2B_RATE_CARD_DELETED, B2B_RATE_CARD_EXCEL_IMPORTED, B2B_RATE_CARD_ACTIVATED, B2B_RATE_CARD_ARCHIVED, B2B_RATE_CARD_ROLLBACK, B2B_RATE_CARD_MARKUP_UPDATED]. Logs store timestamp, actor ID, changelog, and replaced card IDs for historical reproducibility.

title: Existing Seller and Admin Login and JWT Authentication Verification
evidence: Both Admin and Seller authentication verified: Bcrypt password comparison passed, login schema validation passed, JWT token generation & verification passed for both SUPER_ADMIN and SELLER roles.
